title: De la Historia a la Evidencia — ¿Qué debería probar?

steps.title: De la Historia a la Evidencia — ¿Qué debería probar?
steps.objective: Frame the session's flow and its guiding question before any content.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: State the flow aloud: Jira → AC → escenarios → Postman → evidencia. Land the guiding question — ¿qué debería probar? — without answering it yet.
actions: Read the title and framing line aloud
State the guiding question for the session

steps.title: ¿Qué probaría?
steps.objective: Surface the group's instinct before showing any real evidence.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Ask the question, take a few quick answers, and let disagreement stand. Do not resolve it here — the session builds toward the answer.
questions: ¿Qué probaría antes de ver ninguna evidencia?

steps.title: PET-142 · Agregar una mascota al catálogo
steps.objective: Introduce the Jira story the whole session builds on.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Read the story aloud. Keep the group focused on understanding intent — do not let anyone start writing requests yet.
actions: State the slide's framing: convertir una historia sencilla en evidencia útil

steps.title: Criterios de aceptación
steps.objective: Model reading acceptance criteria for behavior, not for test cases.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Walk each AC line and ask what verb, condition, or observable it implies. Resist jumping to Postman — this is still a reading exercise.
questions: ¿Qué verbo, condición u observable implica cada criterio?

steps.title: Example Mapping
steps.objective: Introduce Example Mapping before pairs use it themselves.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Model exactly one Regla/Ejemplos pair live, mirroring the on-screen cards. Leave the slide's open question for pairs to explore next.
questions: ¿Qué valida el producto cuando falta un campo?

steps.title: Lea la historia, identifique reglas y escriba ejemplos y preguntas
steps.objective: Have pairs turn the story and AC into rules, examples, and open questions.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Circulate while pairs fill Regla → Ejemplos → Preguntas on the worksheet. Use the instructor answer key to validate the group's mapping, not to hand out answers.
actions: Circulate while pairs complete the Example Mapping worksheet
doNotReveal: No mostrar la clave de respuestas del instructor a los participantes.

steps.title: H/A/N/E como lente de descubrimiento
steps.objective: Synthesize Happy/Alternative/Negative/Edge as a discovery lens, not a taxonomy debate.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Land the slide's own point: la etiqueta importa menos que por qué el escenario importa. Do not let the group get stuck arguing borderline labels.

steps.title: Priorizar antes de liberar
steps.objective: Practice prioritizing scenarios under a release constraint.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Pose the four-scenario constraint and probe for impacto de negocio, riesgo de integración, and información que falta. Use the answer key's recommended priorities only to check the group's reasoning.
questions: Si solo pudiera ejecutar cuatro escenarios, ¿cuáles aportarían la evidencia más sólida?
doNotReveal: No mostrar la clave de respuestas del instructor a los participantes.

steps.title: Evidencia inicial en Postman
steps.objective: Show a status-code-only assertion and ask whether it is enough.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Run the Starter Collection's create request asserting only status 200, then ask ¿es suficiente? Let the question hang before slide 10 answers it.
actions: Run the Create request from the Starter Collection
Show only the status-200 assertion passing
doNotReveal: No mostrar la Solution Collection todavía; se usa hasta la demostración de Newman (Slide 15).

steps.title: Evidencia más sólida
steps.objective: Identify which response fields actually deserve an assertion.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Walk the ID → name → status → photoUrls progression and ask what each one proves about the promised behavior.
doNotReveal: No mostrar la Solution Collection todavía; se usa hasta la demostración de Newman (Slide 15).

steps.title: Encadenamiento de solicitudes
steps.objective: Demonstrate chaining a create request into a retrieve request.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Show capturing the created id with pm.collectionVariables.set('createdPetId', body.id) and reusing it in the retrieve request before comparing the two.
actions: Demonstrate capturing createdPetId via a collection variable
Chain the retrieve request using the captured id
doNotReveal: No mostrar la Solution Collection todavía; se usa hasta la demostración de Newman (Slide 15).

steps.title: Construya validaciones y encadene Create con Retrieve
steps.objective: Have pairs build meaningful assertions and chain Create with Retrieve themselves.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Circulate with probing questions (e.g. ¿qué valor debe verse sin cambios en la respuesta?). Reveal the intentionally weak 200-only assertion only once groups have already started.
actions: Reveal the prepared weak 200-only assertion once groups have begun
doNotReveal: No mostrar la clave de respuestas del instructor a los participantes.
No mostrar la Solution Collection todavía; se usa hasta la demostración de Newman (Slide 15).

steps.title: Escenario negativo controlado
steps.objective: Investigate what an unknown numeric ID actually returns.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Run the controlled non-happy request against an unknown numeric ID and let the group observe the documented 404 before naming what remains an open question.
actions: Run the controlled non-happy request against an unknown numeric ID
Let the group observe the result before explaining it
doNotReveal: No revelar que el resultado será 404 antes de que el grupo lo observe.

steps.title: Lo que pueden demostrar las validaciones de API
steps.objective: Draw the boundary between what API assertions can and cannot prove.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Contrast what the responses actually demonstrated (respuesta, valores, IDs, 404) against what they never touched (datos persistidos, logs, dependencias).
doNotReveal: No mostrar la Solution Collection todavía; se usa hasta la demostración de Newman (Slide 15).

steps.title: Newman repite la colección
steps.objective: Run the Solution Collection with Newman and compare it with the earlier Postman run.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Run the pinned Newman command from the instructor machine only. Land the slide's point — Newman no hace fuertes las pruebas débiles — do not teach installation, reporters, or CLI options.
actions: Run the Newman command against the Solution Collection
Compare the Newman output with the earlier Postman run

checklist.label: Solution Collection lista para el teaser de Newman

steps.title: Todo está en verde. ¿Terminamos?
steps.objective: Hold the confidence-boundary question open before bridging to Session 2.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Ask the question and let disagreement surface before naming what remains unverified: base de datos, logs, dependencias, reintentos, estado real.
doNotReveal: No revelar todavía la conclusión de la Sesión 2.

steps.title: Puente hacia la Sesión 2
steps.objective: Recap the session's arc and bridge to Session 2's deeper evidence question.
steps.facilitatorGuidance: Recap Historia → Escenarios → Validaciones → Confianza, then close with the bridge question: ¿qué ocurrió fuera de la respuesta HTTP? This buffer also protects hands-on time and exit tickets.
actions: Recap the Historia → Escenarios → Validaciones → Confianza arc
State the bridge question for Session 2
